schema.title: Universal Target

description:
We’re setting up the universal build for **my‑app** with the production browser configuration `my-app:build:production` and the matching server target `my-app:server:production`. Before each build we’ll clean the output directory, and we’ll keep verbose logging turned on to capture detailed information. The file‑loader will not emit any files (as expected for a server build), and we’ll limit bundled dependencies to the whitelisted packages **lodash** and **express**.

Two file replacements are defined for this build: the environment file `src/environments/environment.ts` will be swapped out for `src/environments/environment.prod.ts`, and the entry point `src/main.ts` will be replaced with `src/main.server.ts`. In addition, the build will incorporate the partial webpack configurations located at `webpack.browser.partial.js` for the browser bundle and `webpack.server.partial.js` for the server bundle.
